source: Jabatan Kemajuan Islam Malaysia (JAKIM), zone MLK01 (Seluruh Negeri Melaka). Full year 2026 (365 dates), fetched live from the official https://www.e-solat.gov.my/index.php?r=esolatApi/takwimsolat endpoint (requires a real browser User-Agent header, otherwise it 500s; no session/auth needed).
Times are transcribed directly from that response, not computed by this library. Coordinates are Kuala Linggi (2 deg 23min N, 101 deg 59min E), JAKIM's official reference point for Melaka.
